town_B: A painterly realist oil painting of a quiet cobbled town square seen from high above, late afternoon. Low warm sunlight from the upper right, long soft-edged shadows falling to the lower left. Painted with visible, controlled brushstrokes of one consistent size, simplified textures, few small details, soft blended edges and no outlines, strong readable shapes and a deliberate value structure. Rounded cobblestones of uneven sizes, worn smooth, with earthy joints; opaque packed earth and trodden brown mud; weathered wood and stone with moss and grime; sun-faded striped canvas. Warm golden sunlight on the stones, shadows full of deep blue and violet colour; rich natural colours a little more vibrant than life. Realistic forms and proportions.
town_C: A bold painterly oil painting of a quiet cobbled town square seen from high above, late afternoon. Strong low golden sunlight from the upper right, long cool shadows falling to the lower left. Broad confident oil brushstrokes, simplified graphic shapes, large clear masses of light and shadow, painted texture everywhere, soft edges and no outlines. Chunky cobblestones of uneven sizes with earthy joints; opaque packed earth and trodden mud; weathered wood and stone; sun-faded striped canvas. Glowing golden light, violet and deep blue shadows, vivid rich colour. Realistic forms and proportions, slightly exaggerated sturdy shapes.
ford_B: A painterly realist oil painting of a wide river ford at night seen from high above. Deep blue water with long moonlit ripples, soft reflections and thin drifting mist, pale stepping stones, a pale frosted bank and a cobbled landing at the bottom; warm ember light pooling on the water round a small figure at the centre, amber lantern light below her. Painted with visible, controlled brushstrokes of one consistent size, simplified textures, few small details, soft blended edges and no outlines, strong readable shapes and a deliberate value structure. Cold moonlight in blue and teal against warm ember orange and lantern amber, shadows of deep blue and violet colour, never grey or black. Realistic forms and proportions.
ford_C: A bold painterly oil painting of a wide river ford at night seen from high above. Luminous deep ultramarine and teal water with sweeping moonlit ripples and drifting mist, pale stepping stones, a pale frosted bank and a cobbled landing at the bottom; glowing ember light round a small figure at the centre, amber lantern light below her. Broad confident oil brushstrokes, simplified graphic shapes, large clear masses of light and shadow, painted texture everywhere, soft edges and no outlines. Glowing moonlight against warm ember orange and lantern amber, violet and deep blue shadows, vivid rich colour. Realistic forms and proportions.
close_B: A painterly realist oil painting of a night camp in a pine forest, a close view at eye level. A woman in blue steel armour stands at the centre, warmly lit from the left by a tall campfire in the left foreground; firelight spills over split logs, a small wooden chest and the ground; a big round wooden shield with an iron rim at the right; behind her dark pine trunks fade into cold blue moonlit haze. Painted with visible, controlled brushstrokes of one consistent size, simplified textures, few small details, soft blended edges and no outlines, strong readable shapes and a deliberate value structure. Warm firelight amber against cold moonlit blue and teal, shadows of deep blue, violet and green colour, never grey or black. Realistic forms and proportions.
